Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

tidyindex 0.2.0

  • rescaling() can now rescale multiple variables in one call, with parameters (e.g. min, max) taken from the parameter table added by add_paras().
  • New variable transformation trans_affine().
  • New datasets aqi, aqi_ref_tbl, and pollutant_ref_tbl, and a new vignette showing how to compute the Air Quality Index (AQI) (contributed by Walter Wang).
  • idx_spi(), idx_spei(), idx_rdi(), and idx_edi() now return the index in the .index column, and compute_indexes() keeps intermediate columns.
  • The package now depends on R >= 4.1.0, as it uses the native pipe |>.
  • Maintainer email updated to huizezhangsh@gmail.com.

tidyindex 0.1.0

CRAN release: 2023-11-16

  • Initial CRAN submission.
